name: config-managed-by
description: A device whose primary syncs its settings shows them in /config as read-only rows marked 'managed by <primary>': the loadout and model rows, a synced setting, and never the API key. Settings the primary does not send still edit as before. Throwaway HOME, --no-daemon, no keyring (issue #121, Story 8).

setup.description: Throwaway HOME with synced settings and the managed-config record
setup.command:
H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-config-managed-by"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab/private"; chmod 700 "$H/.kollab/private"; ln -sfn "$PWD/plugins" "$H/plugins"; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" "$PWD/.venv/bin/python" - "$H" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path

home = Path(sys.argv[1])
kollab = home / ".kollab"
config = {
    "kollabor": {
        "llm": {
            "active_profile": "anthropic",
            "max_history": 50,
            "profiles": {
                "anthropic": {
                    "provider": "anthropic",
                    "model": "claude-opus-5-5",
                    "api_key": "sk-fake-config-managed-by-1f00",
                }
            },
        },
        "updates": {"check_enabled": False},
    },
    "plugins": {"hub": {"enabled": False}},
}
(kollab / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(config))
keys = [
    ["kollabor", "llm", "active_profile"],
    ["kollabor", "llm", "max_history"],
    ["kollabor", "llm", "profiles", "anthropic", "model"],
    ["kollabor", "llm", "profiles", "anthropic", "api_key"],
]
record = {
    "version": 1,
    "primary_key": "a" * 64,
    "primary_name": "laptop-kollab",
    "revision": 1,
    "digest": "d" * 64,
    "keys": keys,
    "mcp_servers": [],
    "files": {},
}
path = kollab / "private" / "managed-config.json"
path.write_text(json.dumps(record))
path.chmod(0o600)
print("fixture ready")
PY
